response.justification: The candidate is a strong senior full-stack/web software engineer with nearly two decades of experience, but the resume shows no evidence of the core requirements for this role: SoC/IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, GPU or accelerator architecture, or deep-learning workload performance analysis. The closest relevant experience is low-latency systems work in DLang at Dunnhumby, which is software performance engineering rather than hardware/architecture-level performance work. This is a fundamental domain mismatch for a principal-level hardware performance architect position.
strengths: Extensive (15+ years) professional software engineering experience, satisfying the years-of-experience bar
Demonstrated low-latency, high-throughput systems work (async I/O, fibers, caching at millions of requests/sec)
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, and teaching/mentoring track record
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, silicon, or computer architecture experience anywhere in the resume
No deep-learning training/inference optimization or GPU/SIMD/MIMD workload analysis background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack product engineering, not hardware performance architecture at principal level

key_factors.factor: No AI accelerator / DL workload optimization background
Systems-level performance engineering experience (DLang, low-latency services)
